༄༅/ /rgyal mchog thams cad mkhyen pa chen po sku phreng bcu bzhi par zhabs brtan du gsol ba 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: )༄༅// rgyal mchog thams cad mkhyen pa chen po sku phreng bcu bzhi par zhabs brtan du gsol ba 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

oṃ swa sti/ rgyal ba kun gyi brtse chen ye shes sku// gcig tu bsdus pa gangs ri ltar dkar ba// 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug sprul pa'i sku// khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma rgyal gyur cig /srid pa gsum na ngo mtshar zla med pa// u dum wa ra ltar 'phags thams cad mkhyen// 'dzam gling bstan 'gro yongs kyi gtsug nor che// rgyal mchog phyag na pad mor zhabs brtan gsol// gdod nas mngon sangs rgyas kyang rtsod pa'i dus// 'gro rnams phyag gi yal gas nyer 'dzin pa'i// thugs bskyed dam bca' rdo rje lta bur brtan// sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen por zhabs brtan gsol// byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i mngon rtogs kun// gsang ba gsum dang dbyer med 'dres pa las// mkhyen dang brtse ba'i yon tan bsam mi khyab// byang phyogs thub dbang gnyis par zhabs brtan gsol// 'chad rtsod rtsom la chags thogs mi mnga' zhing*// spobs pa'i gter chen brgyad po yongs su grol// so so yang dag rig pa'i chos ston pa// phyogs las rnam rgyal chen por zhabs brtan gsol// blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che// bshad sgrub las kyi 'khor los phyogs brgyar spel// rgol ngan bdud kyi glang po'i klad pa 'gems// 'jigs bral smra ba'i seng ger zhabs brtan gsol// snang gsum rgyud gsum gsang sngags lam gyi rim// dbang bzhi rnal 'byor zab mo'i 'gros bzhir thim// sku bzhi'i ye shes mngon sum brnyes mdzad pa// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang zhabs brtan gsol// dngos po kun gyi gnas lugs phyag rgya che// zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i lhan skyes kyi// ye shes nyi mas srid zhi'i mun sel ba// rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen por zhabs brtan gsol// rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i gsang ba kun gyi mdzod// smin grol kha 'bab rnam bzhi'i rgyun bzang po// skal bzang gdul bya'i zhing sar 'dren mdzad pa// gsang ba 'dzin pa'i bdag por zhabs brtan gsol// 'khor 'das chos kun rten 'brel rol par shar// shar yang gdod nas skye med rab zhi ba// spros pa kun bral zab mo dbu ma'i lam// ston mkhas klu yi dbang por zhabs brtan gsol// phyi nang gzhan gsum dbyer med dus 'khor lo// legs par 'dom mkhas rigs ldan padma dkar// bho ḍa'i ljongs su dge ba'i bshes su ston// dang po'i sangs rgyas ngo bor zhabs brtan gsol// 'khor 'das chos kun 'od gsal thig le'i klong*// bri gang med par lhun gyis rdzogs pa che// byar med rang grol 'bras bu'i rgyal sa snyogs// kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon por zhabs brtan gsol// mdor na thub bstan yongs rdzogs shing rta che// ma 'dres phyag gis 'dren la snyengs pa bral// bstan dang 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gcig pu// bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i dbang por zhabs brtan gsol// srid pa gsum gyi che rgu'i gtsug nor gyis// gang gi zhabs pad bkra shis 'khor lo la// gus shing 'dar bcas lan brgyar btud pa yis// chos kyi rgyal po chen por zhabs brtan gsol// lha min bdud sde tshar gcod lha yi dbang*// mthu stobs nus pa'i rdo rje rtse brgya pas// lta ngan log lta'i brag ri 'joms mdzad pa// 'jigs mdzad he ru ka dpal zhabs brtan gsol// sa dang lhun po nyi zla gnas kyi bar// gsang gsum gzhan du 'gyur ba med pa yis// gru 'dzin 'phags mchog dgyes pa'i gzhal med khang*// rdo rje'i khri la gzhom bral brtan bzhugs gsol// 'chi med lha mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*// bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems kyi// bden pa'i stobs kyis ji ltar gsol ba'i don// gegs med 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol//

zhes sgo gsum dngos po kun gyi btud de shar mdo khams kyi ljongs su gnas pa mkhyen brtse'i sprul ming 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs chos kyi blo gros pas gus pa chen pos/ dbus 'gyur 'chang lha ldan ra sa 'phrul snang gi chos 'khor chen po'i lho phyogs bsam 'grub pho brang gi gzim shag tu gsol ba btab pa bzhin bris te thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po'i spyan sngar phul ba 7zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtshor bzhugs pa'i rgyur gyur cig// / ༈ gangs ri'i rwa bas bskor ba'i zhing khams 'dir// phan dang bde ba ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas// spyan ras gzigs dbang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho yi// zhabs pad srid mtha'i bar du brtan gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni/ zhabs dkar tshogs drug rang grol gyis thams cad mkhyen pa 7rgyal dbang sku phreng dgu pa lung rtogs rgya mtshor phul ba'i gsol 'debs da bar 7rgyal dbang rim byon gyi mtshan bsgyur gyis mang tshogs yongs nas 'don chog tshig nyung don bsdus byin rlabs can no/// /
